cleaned_text: HDFC Flexi Cap Fund - Scheme Information Document HDFC Flexi Cap Fund - Scheme Information Document (SID) AMC: HDFC Asset Management Company Limited SEBI Registration Number: MF/022/95/5 1. Scheme Details Scheme Name: HDFC Flexi Cap Fund (formerly known as HDFC Equity Fund) Type: Open-Ended Equity Scheme - Flexi Cap Fund Investment Objective: To provide long-term capital appreciation by investing in equity and equity-related securities across market capitalizations. The fund manager has flexibility to dynamically allocate between large-cap, mid-cap, and small-cap stocks based on prevailing market conditions and valuations. 2. Asset Allocation Pattern Equity and Equity-related instruments across market capitalizations: 65% to 100% (High Risk) Debt Securities, Government Securities, and Money Market Instruments: 0% to 35% (Low to Medium Risk) Units issued by REITs and InvITs: 0% to 10% (Very High Risk) As a flexi-cap fund, SEBI mandates a minimum 65% allocation to equity instruments but provides flexibility in market-cap allocation. The fund is required to invest a minimum of 65% in equity across large, mid, and small-cap categories without any sub-category minimum. 3. Investment Strategy The fund employs a multi-cap investment approach with the flexibility to dynamically shift allocations based on market conditions. Key aspects of the strategy include: Bottom-up stock selection combined with top-down macro overlay Focus on businesses with strong competitive moats and pricing power Preference for companies with demonstrated track record of earnings growth Valuation-conscious approach — willingness to hold cash when opportunities are limited Active management of market-cap allocation based on relative valuations Emphasis on quality of earnings and return on capital employed 4. Risk Management Diversification across 50-60 stocks to mitigate single-stock risk Maximum single stock exposure limited to 10% as per SEBI regulations Sector limits monitored to avoid excessive concentration Regular portfolio stress testing under adverse market scenarios Liquidity assessment of holdings to ensure orderly redemption capability 5. Who Should Invest HDFC Flexi Cap Fund is suitable for investors seeking long-term wealth creation through equity market exposure, who can tolerate short-term volatility, have a minimum 5-year investment horizon, and prefer a diversified equity fund with flexibility across market capitalizations. Not suitable for short-term investors or those seeking guaranteed returns. 6. Fund Manager Primary Fund Manager: Mr. Roshi Jain Co-Fund Manager: Mr. Dhruv Muchhal Experience: Mr. Jain has 18+ years of experience. Previously at Franklin Templeton Investments. Qualification: CFA Charter Holder, MBA from XLRI Jamshedpur 7. Benchmark Primary Benchmark: Nifty 500 TRI (Total Returns Index) Additional Benchmark: BSE Sensex TRI 8. Expenses and Loads Entry Load: Nil Exit Load: 1.00% if redeemed within 365 days; Nil after 365 days TER (Direct Plan): 0.78% per annum TER (Regular Plan): 1.62% per annum Transaction Charges: Rs. 100 (existing) / Rs. 150 (new) for investments ≥ Rs. 10,000 via distributor 9. Minimum Investment Lumpsum (New): Rs. 100 and in multiples of Re. 1 Additional Purchase: Rs. 100 and in multiples of Re. 1 Minimum SIP: Rs. 100 per month Minimum SWP: Rs. 500 per installment Minimum STP: Rs. 500 per installment 10. Tax Treatment STCG (less than 12 months): 20% plus surcharge and cess LTCG (more than 12 months): 12.5% on gains exceeding Rs. 1.25 lakh per FY Dividends: Taxable at slab rate, TDS 10% if exceeding Rs. 5,000/FY STT: 0.001% on redemption 11. Statutory Disclosures Mutual Fund investments are subject to market risks. The NAV may fluctuate due to market conditions, economic factors, and performance of underlying securities. Past performance does not guarantee future returns. The AMC does not assure any dividend or returns. Investors should read the SID, SAI, and KIM carefully before investing.
